description:
£165 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to offer to the student lettings market this five bedroom mid terrace house, ideally situated on Cavendish Place in the heart of Jesmond.

The accommodation briefly comprises a living room featuring a period fire surround, a generous fitted kitchen and the first bedroom to the ground floor. To the first floor, there are four further bedrooms, a bathroom fitted with both a bath and separate shower, and a separate WC.

The property retains a number of charming period features and further benefits from double glazing throughout and gas central heating. The kitchen is well equipped with a dishwasher, washer/dryer and microwave, while the living room benefits from a smart TV.

Externally, the property boasts a private rear yard, along with a secure outdoor shed providing convenient bike storage.

Ideally located and offering spacious student accommodation with fantastic additional features, this property is not to be missed!

To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
